accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images uses proper overlays for readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML + Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn for the Quote Request form.
Implement lucide-react for icons (e.g., thermal insulation, noise reduction, security).
Use 'Playfair Display' for headings (import via Google Fonts in index.css) and 'Manrope' for body.
Maintain a clean, architectural layout with generous spacing (py-24, px-8).
Build a sticky navigation bar with glassmorphism.
Ensure the hero image has a max bg-black/40 overlay so the Rapid Bay beach is clearly visible.
Do NOT use placeholder images; rely exclusively on the provided media URLs.
In the Deceuninck section, emphasize the technical specs (5-chamber, 76mm wing, up to 52mm glazing) with premium typography.
